name: paceflow-reader
description: A calm, private pace reader for real books, with smart rhythm, context and reliable progress.

scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run cap:sync && npm run verify:package
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:production
scripts.test:legacy: playwright test test-comprehensive-functionality.spec.js test-bottom-tap-zone.spec.js test-epub.spec.js test-format-imports.spec.js test-library-bookmarks.spec.js test-mobile-doubletap.spec.js test-last-word-stopping.spec.js --project=chromium

author: Vovka (DoroninDobroCorp)
